external_collaboration.evidence_quote: This project aims to strengthen academic and scientific cooperation between the Institute for Informatics and Automation Problems (IIAP) in Yerevan and Toulouse INP, through staff and student exchanges focusing on artificial intelligence and high-performance computing, with practical applications in the environment, health and agriculture. It forms part of the EU-Armenia strategic partnership and aims to develop local skills, notably through training and the use of supercomputers.

This project aims to strengthen cooperation between Toulouse INP and the University of Monastir through student and staff exchanges, jointly supervised theses and the joint development of a double diploma in the field of sustainable biotechnology. It combines training, applied research and the promotion of biodiversity to address the economic, environmental and industrial challenges facing south-eastern Tunisia, whilst enhancing the employability of young graduates.
